verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list Web as a supported platform, describe a web client you can host on your own domain, and say version 1.5.0 adds WebRTC paths that enable direct access from the web client. That covers viewing or controlling a remote machine from a browser without installing a client. missing for 10: explicit documentation that both view-only and full control work in the web client, any feature limits or plan requirements for the web client, independent hands-on corroboration of browser access.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: Host the web client on your server with your domain name to make remote access even easier.
Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Web.
RustDesk 1.5.0 adds WebRTC connection paths, enables direct access from the web client
